topics.title: Ukraine talks move to Kyiv
topics.summary: U.S. envoys met Ukrainian leaders after Moscow talks, with air defense, winter energy support, security guarantees, and reconstruction all on the table.
topics.discussionPrompt: If a peace pitch arrives after a Moscow meeting, what would make the studio cautiously hopeful instead of just suspicious?

topics.title: Hormuz claim raises tension
topics.summary: Iran said it struck an unmanned U.S. vessel near the Strait of Hormuz, while the U.S. denied the claim amid wider tanker and missile tensions.
topics.discussionPrompt: When two sides describe the same sea incident completely differently, who in the studio starts checking maps and oil prices?

topics.title: Volcano disrupts Indonesia flights
topics.summary: Anak Krakatau eruptions sent ash across western Indonesia, shutting airports, cancelling flights, and pushing officials to warn people away from the crater.
topics.discussionPrompt: If ash clouds grounded everyone, who would handle the schedule calmly and who would immediately overpack snacks?

topics.title: Mail-ballot fight returns
topics.summary: The Trump administration again asked the Supreme Court to allow mail-ballot restrictions as states prepare ballots for the 2026 midterms.
topics.discussionPrompt: If election rules are still being argued while ballots are going out, what would make regular voters feel clear on what to do?

topics.title: Canadian travelers prove hard to win back
topics.summary: U.S. tourism groups are trying discounts and promotions to lure Canadian visitors, but trade tensions and politics are weighing on cross-border trips.
topics.discussionPrompt: What would actually win back a cautious traveler: a bargain, a warmer welcome, or just less drama at the border?

topics.title: Inflation data looms over Fed
topics.summary: Markets are watching August inflation numbers before the Federal Reserve meets, with economists focused on whether price pressure changes the rate outlook.
topics.discussionPrompt: Why does one inflation report make everyone act like they are waiting for exam results?

topics.title: Summer box office ends strong
topics.summary: Spider-Man stayed No. 1 for a sixth week as Hollywood wrapped its strongest summer box-office season in years, helped by several big crowd-pleasers.
topics.discussionPrompt: What keeps people showing up for the same hit movie: comfort, spectacle, friends dragging friends, or pure curiosity?

topics.title: NBC voice marks milestone season
topics.summary: Broadcaster Dan Hicks marked his 35th NBC Sports season while calling Notre Dame and Wisconsin from Lambeau Field, reflecting on decades across major events.
topics.discussionPrompt: Who in the studio would be best at making one voice feel familiar for decades of big sports moments?

topics.title: Smart-ring IPO draws attention
topics.summary: NPR reported smart-ring maker Aura is preparing a major IPO, drawing interest around wearable health data, subscriptions, and biometric privacy.
topics.discussionPrompt: Would the studio wear a health ring if it meant useful tips, or would everyone argue over who sees the data?

topics.title: Roman telescope launch sparks interest
topics.summary: NPR highlighted the launch of the Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope, a mission expected to deepen studies of planets, galaxies, and dark energy.
topics.discussionPrompt: If a new space telescope could answer one giant question, what would the studio vote to point it at first?
